title: Ralph Module Tasks
description: Per-module task list consumed by the implement-prd Ralph loop. One file per PRD module: {module}-tasks.json.

module.description: Module slug, matches the PRD filename without extension (e.g. 'membership-flow-overview' or 'membership-flow-login').

prd_path.description: Repo-relative path to the PRD module markdown file (e.g. 'Brain/PRDs/05_02_2026/membership-flow/membership-flow.md').

agent.description: Default sub-agent type the loop spawns for tasks in this module. Per-task override allowed via task.agent.

id.description: Ordered task id, e.g. T01, T02. Loop picks lowest id whose passes=false and all depends_on are passes=true.

description.description: What to do, with enough technical detail that a fresh sub-agent can execute without re-reading the whole PRD.

files.description: Files this task is allowed to create or modify. >5 files means split the task.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be passes=true before this one becomes eligible.

acceptance.description: Bullets copied from the PRD's User Stories or Implementation Decisions that THIS task satisfies. Used by Step 6 to compose the verification report.

validation.description: Gates run after the sub-agent finishes. Default: ['typecheck', 'lint:touched']. All must pass before passes flips to true. 'build' is reserved for end-of-loop and should NOT appear per-task.

agent.description: Optional per-task override of the module-level agent.

passes.description: Loop flips to true after all validation gates pass.

attempts.description: Loop increments on each failed iteration. Halts when attempts >= 3.

notes.description: Loop-appended log: errors hit, decisions made, follow-ups.
